subject: Parameter Files for Nanopore made of Si3N4(Silicon Nitride)

messages.author: Vishal Reddy
messages.body:
Respected members,
I am trying to do some simulations on nanopore made of material Si3N4 in AMBER, Can someone help me with the methods to generate parameter files for Si3N4 in AMBER, or if someone has already done it please do share the files.
Thanks You
Vishal
